name: bboxy design system
owner: operator (bboxy450); written by Lumen Foxglove <CREATIVITY> from the lab
principles: every pixel is precious: no outer padding, 2 px gutters, chrome takes no space it does not use
one material, one radius scale, one type scale, one spacing grid, one motion curve
colour means identity only (seat, swarm, role); state is glyph and glow; selection is a tint
one signal per meaning, one meaning per signal; nothing animates without a cause
click changes what you see; hover only highlights (panes may take focus on dwell)
a swarm is a world: its own seats, tabs, shadows, stream, panes
rows never reorder; nothing in the sidebar moves on focus
destructive actions are reversible by a window, not a dialog

material.frosted: surface at 78% with 30 px blur and 1.4 saturate for panels; 72% for cards
material.edges: hairline = line at 70%; never a solid border except pane borders (identity)
material.highlight: inset 1 px top highlight at 8% white on panels
material.shadow: only under floating things (panel, pill, ghost); cards and rows cast none

type.family: system sans; mono for digits, keys, paths

ground.sidebar: sidebar (lighter than bg in dark, darker in light)

identity.seat: hash of key → 36 hues × 2 lightness bands, operator override
identity.swarm: random from key, swatch cycles it

motion.cell_breathe: 1.2 s on a lit preview cell

theme.toggle: one icon in the title bar: sun in dark, moon in light
theme.light_glow: halo darkens toward the seat colour instead of adding light

window.source: renderer.md §1b; tokens [window] opacity 1.0, opacity_min 0.5, blur false, blur_radius 20
window.rule: the window composites over the desktop: pane backgrounds carry the alpha (0.5 to 1.0), chrome and text stay opaque, glow and dim composite over; optional blur of what is behind, 10/20/40 px; subpixel text is impossible over transparency (grayscale already decided)
window.status: built: Settings › Appearance Window opacity (live preview over a wallpaper, slider drags live, release commits), Blur behind, Blur radius; showcase ?opacity=0.5..1&blur=1 with a wallpaper standing in for the desktop; html.transparent / .win-blur in lab.css

border_glow.sidebar_budget: radius 4, 30% alpha, particles only when active, none when idle

locate.stage_switch: fires after the new screen renders

unread_dot.means: a message for this seat is unread

presence_notice.where: centred line in the swarm stream

dim.panes: strip and content desaturate 0.10, opacity 0.45, background wash 28%; border keeps the seat colour
dim.swarms: same tokens on band and rows; bumper keeps the colour

state_grade.drawing: reported = solid glyph; shim = solid with a thin ring; inferred = hollow or dashed glyph; the glow follows the glyph (inferred glows at half alpha)
state_grade.status: built: grade comes from the harness record's state source (osc7501 → reported, hooks → shim, output cadence → inferred); inferred glows at half

waiting_kind.drawing: three variants of ◐: permission = ◐ with a key dot, question = ◐ with a ?, auth = ◐ with a lock; amber for all; the strip subtitle names the kind
waiting_kind.status: built: kind from the pane's prompt (Allow → permission, auth/login/token → auth, ? → question); strip title spells it; key 3 cycles it in the demo

delivery_evidence.source: messaging.md: sender-stored, recipient-stored, native-queued, native-written, native-unknown, application-acknowledged
delivery_evidence.drawing: a tick ladder at the right of a message row: ·  ✓  ✓✓  ✓✓✓ for stored → written → acknowledged; unknown is a distinct hollow mark, never red, never a failure
delivery_evidence.status: built: after the time on the row head; sender-stored ·, recipient-stored ✓, native-queued ✓✓ with the second tick at 38%, native-written ✓✓, application-acknowledged ✓✓✓ in accent, native-unknown ✓ then a dashed hollow ring (fg-dim, never red); the tooltip spells the state; tickLadder() in components.js, message-row.html?state=evidence

held_count.drawing: muted row shows a small "held N" badge; on unmute only still-authorised eligible items release, the rest stay with their reason and original ids, so the badge may not reach zero at once

restarted_notice.drawing: one-shot "restarted" chip on the row for 4 s, then a stream line
restarted_notice.status: built: one-shot accent "restarted" chip in the row's right cluster, fades out over 4 s; then a stream line "<name> restarted · process generation N"; seat.restarted, seat-row.html?state=restarted, showcase key D

pending_row.means: the Oracle is spawning this seat
pending_row.source: MCP mutation status accepted | applied | rejected | unknown
pending_row.drawing: a dashed-outline row with a rolled name and a spinner glyph until applied; rejected shows the reason in a closed-strip-like row; partial and unknown stay dashed with the outcome spelled; never turned into a failure, never an automatic second paste or Enter
pending_row.status: built: tab-level row between closed strips and new seat; accepted = dashed outline, spinner, rolled name, "spawning · by <Oracle>"; partial and unknown = dashed with a dashed ring and the outcome spelled on a second line; rejected = closed-strip tint, red ×, the reason; dismiss on the name line; applied removes the row and the seat takes its tab with a stream line; pendingRow() in components.js, sidebar.html?state=pending-spawns, showcase key O

interrupt_signal.source: seat_interrupt → adapter Now/steer; permission belongs to the caller
interrupt_signal.drawing: one-shot "interrupt sent" notice on the row and strip; not a promise that the seat stopped; the operator may interrupt any seat they are allowed to act on
interrupt_signal.status: built: one-shot, 2 px red bar sweeps along the strip bottom and fades, "interrupt sent" chip on strip and row fades over 3 s; seat state unchanged until the seat reports; timestamped so re-renders resume rather than replay; title-strip.html?state=interrupt-sent

authority.means: this seat's signing authority is not good
authority.drawing: a small struck-key mark after the name and a muted strip subtitle naming the cause; controls that need the seat's signature are disabled with the same reason; independent of the state glyph
authority.status: built: struck-key glyph (ICON_SVG.keyx) after the name and role mark, amber for expired, red for revoked and forked; the strip carries the cause as a dark pill ("authority expired · renew the seat grant", "revoked here · peers learn on next contact", "forked · two heads at one epoch · the operator resolves"); controls that need the seat signature (mute and unmute notices) are disabled with the same reason in the strip toggle and the row menu; the state glyph is untouched; seat.authority; seat-row.html?state=authority-expired|authority-revoked|authority-forked; title-strip.html?state=authority-revoked; showcase Sable Quill expired

subagent_addressing.means: who a message is for and who answered (messaging.md Subagent addressing)
subagent_addressing.drawing: message row chips: "→ main" or "→ ↳ <subagent title>"; a reply from a subagent carries "↳ <title>" in the role colour; "via main" in italics when the harness relayed (Claude and Codex: subagent_addressable false); a message to an ended subagent shows an amber dashed "held · agent ended" in place of the ladder, never redirected; the ladder is per target
subagent_addressing.status: built: messageRow m.to, m.fromAgent, m.via, m.held; rowMenu opts.agent (Message this subagent, Message the main agent, Focus seat, Copy agent id); subagent rows open it on right-click; message-row.html?state=to-a-subagent|relayed-via-main|reply-from-a-subagent|agent-ended-held; seat-row.html?state=subagent-menu; showcase right-click a subagent row

routing_discipline.means: workers DM by default; the stream carries chunks, decisions and presence (messaging.md Routing discipline)
routing_discipline.drawing: kind chips CHUNK (ok green) and DECISION (invariant amber) on stream rows; a rejected worker progress note as a dashed red row "⊘ Rook Ashwhisker tried to post progress to the stream · DM your delegator · Vesper Greywind"; subgroup chip "⧉ render crew · 2" for fan-out DMs; #subchannel chip on rows seen in all; a dashed amber "noisy 38%" chip on a seat row whose stream share passes the threshold (for the Oracle)

identity_rules: the app never holds or exports the primary secret: no create-root-key, no export; point at gpg
device enrollment copes with the primary being elsewhere: it produces a signed request, it never pretends
unlock is pinentry and the gpg-agent cache; no password field of ours, no remember-password
revocation wording: revoked here, peers learn on next contact; never revoked everywhere
recovery restores identity only; seats, history and grants are not recovered by the key
the fingerprint is the full 40 hex grouped in 4s; a short id is never the identity
messages and presence are signed by leaf keys; signed by Boxy means the chain verifies to Boxy's key
Google is a link for cloud, drawn as a link, never a sign-in
per-seat commit signing is assumed, not decided: switchable, default off
devices and seats are certified leaf keys, not subkeys
expired, revoked or forked authority blocks controls and messages on its own axis, apart from seat state
a revocation certificate revokes, never restores; recovery needs the protected GPG secret backup or an external paperkey plus its matching public certificate, and restores identity only
attribution proves the signing chain to the pinned primary, never which model authored the content and never a permission to execute it
authority can be cached as available while the primary is offline; enrollment may stay awaiting the primary signature
settings_tab.account: hero: portrait beside the key block; full fingerprint large in mono; ed25519 · signing chip; unlocked · gpg-agent cache; uid line; copy fingerprint; trust path GPG primary → certified device key → certified seat key; primary held by gpg-agent · pinned from your keyring · never exported; device cards are certified leaf keys with revoke (local; peers learn on next contact); enroll card produces a signed request when the primary is elsewhere; Signatures card; Link Google for cloud as a link; paper recovery = the GPG paperkey fallback with the identity-only caption

matching.purpose: typing finds the thing you mean, not the string you typed
tiers: 1 prefix: label words and aliases (goto, go, jump; harness ids)
2 facets: every item carries tags; seats carry harness, where (local|ssh|cloud), host, role, state, swarm, muted; "codex", "ssh", "cloud", "oracle", "waiting" filter Go to by facet
4 fuzzy: subsequence on the label for words of 3+ letters ("nyxc" → Nyx Copperwing)

5 semantic (real app only): the Jev encoder embeds every row (label + subtitle + tags) once and the query per keystroke; cosine over 384-d vectors; rows above 0.55 join the list below the lexical tiers; also re-ranks ties
matching.words: typed words are ANDed: "codex ssh" = Codex seats over ssh; a word that names a parent descends instead (ssh rig codex)
matching.ranking: tier of the first word, then original order; the list never jumps on a keystroke beyond what the tier change requires

jev.what: the local small neural encoder ICQ ships for `icq how`: pocket-encoder/minilm-l3-q4-g32-v1, 384 dimensions, attention-masked mean pooling, L2 normalised, 128 tokens, no daemon, no network, no download
jev.use_in_launcher: embed each row text once when the list is built (seats change rarely); embed the query on each keystroke after a 40 ms debounce; cosine against all rows; merge with lexical tiers by reciprocal rank fusion; show at most 5 semantic-only rows under a "Related" section so lexical hits stay on top
use_elsewhere: Go to by meaning: "the one doing the gpu research" → Rook
stream search: find messages by meaning across a swarm
command palette later: verbs by meaning ("shut this" → close seat)
sidebar Shadows and stream ordering by relevance to the focused seat, opt-in
jev.limits: queries over 128 tokens truncate; names from the fantasy / sci-fi / furry pools are out of vocabulary for the encoder, so names stay lexical (tier 1) and semantic covers titles, roles, states and messages
jev.cost: one forward pass per keystroke on a 3-layer MiniLM; sub-millisecond on M-series; rows cached

ordering.what: with an empty field, rows are ordered by closeness to the context, not by a fixed list
ordering.context_vector: the focused seat (name, title, harness, role, state, where), the swarm name, the last three launcher picks, the last three stream messages, and the time since the seat last changed state; embedded as one short text, refreshed when any of those change
ordering.suggestions_section: the top three rows by cosine to the context vector become the Suggestions section; the rest keep their section order; a row never moves within its section on a keystroke
examples: focused seat is a waiting Codex over ssh → Suggestions: Go to ▸ that seat, SSH ▸ rig ▸ Codex, Split right
last three picks were cloud launches → Cloud rises above SSH
stream is full of gpu talk → the gpu-research seat rises in Go to
ordering.with_a_query: lexical tiers decide membership; Jev breaks ties inside a tier and orders the Related section
ordering.frequency_is_not_jev: plain counts order placements (if you mostly split right, Split right is first); Jev orders by meaning, counts order by habit; counts win inside a tier when both apply
ordering.never: reorder while the user is holding a key or within 300 ms of the last keystroke; reorder rows the user can reach by number keys without re-numbering them
